SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS "id", a.name AS "name", a.person_type AS "personType", a.gender AS "gender", -- 使用COALESCE函数，优先使用关联表数据，为空时使用swm_person表中保存的数据（需要翻译） COALESCE(o.office_name, backup_o.office_name) AS "company", COALESCE(p.position_name, backup_p.position_name) AS "department", COALESCE(fpl.prod_line_name, backup_fpl.prod_line_name) AS "prodLine", COALESCE(wg.work_group_name, backup_wg.work_group_name) AS "team", COALESCE(f.work_type, backup_wt.work_type) AS "jobType", a.safety_helmet_id AS "safetyHelmetId", a.personnel_status AS "personnelStatus", a.safety_education AS "safetyEducation", a.identity_card AS "identityCard", a.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", a.helmet_returned AS "helmetReturned", a.departure_type AS "departureType", a.departure_reason AS "departureReason", a.departure_date AS "departureDate", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.status AS "status" FROM swm_person a -- 原有的关联查询（通过fms_worker关联） LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id -- 备用关联查询（直接使用swm_person表中保存的ID进行翻译） LEFT JOIN js_sys_office backup_o ON a.company = backup_o.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive backup_p ON a.department = backup_p.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group backup_wg ON a.team = backup_wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line backup_fpl ON a.prod_line = backup_fpl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON a.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE a.personnel_status IN ('1') and a.status = '0'
AND (
(p.id = #{node.id} OR a.department = #{node.id})
(wg.id = #{node.id} OR a.team = #{node.id})
(fpl.id = #{node.id} OR a.prod_line = #{node.id})
(o.office_code = #{node.id} OR a.company = #{node.id})
a.identity_card = #{node.idCard}
)
ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
